boundary: Repository-owned public HTML routes, code owners, provider bindings, acceptance evidence, and explicit gaps. The current candidate build owns 54 HTML routes plus an explicit 404. Twenty-seven Japanese candidates are noindex and excluded from sitemap/hreflang/public language switching until the coordinated Japanese release gate. J7 is candidate-complete after Japanese About, Support, Contact, Changelog, Terms, Privacy, Refund Policy, and Commercial Disclosure candidates are present. All fixed informational/legal candidates reuse the existing shared static-page shell except Changelog, which reuses /data/changelog.json and the shared locale-aware Changelog runtime. The existing Stripe-hosted support flow, Google Form contact flow, policy effective dates, English public policy surfaces, and transaction-disclosure boundaries remain unchanged. Japanese product routes continue to reuse their existing provider-separated runtimes and APIs without changing collector, storage, cadence, retention, geography/evidence, or Current/IRL semantics. Historical Phase 12/R12A acceptance evidence remains separately preserved.
